Eating it won't restore many hearts, but it will lower your body temperature a bit.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen Basses are a type of [[Frozen Food]], and they are made when either a [[Hyrule Bass]] or a [[Staminoka Bass]] are exposed to [[Freezing Climate]]s or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} When eaten, a Frozen Bass will restore two [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]] and grant one minute of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen Basses reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Hyrule Bass]]es or [[Staminoka Bass]]es to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. [[Link]] can eat a Frozen Bass to restore two [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]] and receive one minute of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bass * Food * Frozen Food * Frozen Hearty Bass * Roasted Bass }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
